human_reviewed_interpretation_notes.finding: Opus described the HIGH_VELOCITY signal alongside UNKNOWN behaviour status as a conflict; Sonnet described it as an unresolved indicator without a source contradiction. Both retained uncertainty and returned CHALLENGED.

limitations: One live trial per model and synthetic case does not establish statistical equivalence.
These results do not establish production fraud-detection accuracy.
Policy agreement is governance compliance, not independent fraud accuracy.
Lexical differences alone are not treated as meaningful interpretation differences.
recommendation: Sonnet matched Opus on all grader outcomes, policy recommendations, delegation counts, and safety checks while reducing latency and estimated cost. This single-trial synthetic evaluation provides no measured justification for Opus as Supervisor.
